title: Script
description: A per-language narration script produced by the Script Writer Agent (L4). Mirrors backend/app/schemas.py::Script. PRD section 6.2.

script_id.description: Generated server-side (scr_xxxxxxxx). Absent on a payload the client constructs.

job_id.description: The Job this script belongs to.

language.description: ISO 639-1 code: hi, mr, ta, bn, te, kn, ml, gu, pa, or.

scenes.description: Scenes in narration order. The writer targets 4-6.

scene_id.description: Stable across repair — a repaired scene keeps its id so the script reassembles in order. Also used as FactCheck.claim_id.

text.description: The narration for this scene. Spoken text, not prose.

referenced_fact_ids.description: Fact.id values this scene draws on. A scene referencing no fact is not allowed to exist.

visual_keywords.description: Concrete, depictable nouns feeding the L3 visual provider chain. Produced by the writer, not re-derived downstream.
